verdict.rationale: Alloy's homepage claims "fully auditable agentic automation" for KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks. That is a first-party claim of an in-product agent for AML-type work with an audit trail, but it is a single marketing line with no detail on screening matches specifically. Missing for 10: documentation of an agent that reviews screening or watchlist matches, evidence of per-decision recorded rationale, docs on configuration or human oversight, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
